# Integration choice challenge preparation result

Status: **candidate Lab Challenge Contract/v1 and draft policy; no active challenge or owner Decision**.

The [Lab-shaped Challenge Contract](../../model/lab-records/integration-choice-challenge-contract.json) applies the existing Lab definition and carrier to future integration option reviews, verification contracts, owner Decisions and release bindings. Its [draft policy](../../model/integration/RECONSIDERATION-POLICY.md) and [seven trigger clauses](../../model/integration/challenge-triggers.json) cover scale economics, new requirements and features, API/version breaks, quality and validity, privacy/security/terms, reliability and exit risk. All six [option reviews](../../model/integration/index.json) now reference the candidate contract and applicable ground IDs. The prospective technical verification contracts remain separate.

The contract specifies eligible challengers, acceptable grounds, evidence kinds, response modes, proposed response periods, owner route, resolution gate and unresolved residue handling. Its policy is unissued and thresholds are open. Filing a challenge does not itself suspend a selection. A later challenge event, comparative verification, owner disposition and successor Integration Binding would need distinct records. No such instance exists.

The [current carrier coverage](../../model/carriers/coverage.json) counts 150 selected Lab carrier candidate records, 154 local carrier candidates, 18 Artifact Type Requests and 15 explicit gaps. [AT-G14](../../model/carriers/gaps.json) tracks policy adoption, numerical thresholds, check results and future Decision/challenge execution. [Structural validation](../../tools/validate_challenge_contract.py) checks the Lab schema, seven grounds, policy source and six linked reviews. The [fresh exact Lab review cut](../../../CyberAlchemy-lab/docs/proposals/engineer-assessment-research/2026-10-26/integration-challenge-v1/manifest.json) pins these files for owner inspection; it grants no Lab admission or operational authority.
